**Location:** Marietta GA  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**About Fit Foodz**

Fit Foodz is a growing chicken company focused on providing quality food and exceptional service to our customers. We are looking for a highly organized, detail\-oriented person to join our office team and help keep our day\-to\-day administrative operations running smoothly.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **organized, efficient, and dependable Office \& Administrative Coordinator** who enjoys working with information, systems, documents, and people. This person will play an important role in keeping our customer information, reports, product specifications, and company files accurate and organized.

The ideal candidate is someone who **pays attention to the details, learns quickly, stays calm under pressure, and takes pride in keeping things structured and efficient.**

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain and organize our customer database and customer information
* Organize, structure, and maintain our Dropbox and digital filing systems
* Create, update, and maintain reports and spreadsheets
* Work extensively in **Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint**
* Update product specification sheets and other company documents
* Enter, review, and maintain data accurately
* Navigate and manage information across multiple online portals and systems
* Help keep customer and product information current and accurate
* Prepare reports and documents for management and customers
* Assist with administrative projects and day\-to\-day office needs
* Identify opportunities to improve organization and efficiency
* Communicate professionally and patiently with customers, vendors, and team members
* Learn new software, portals, and processes quickly

**What We're Looking For**

* **Highly detail\-oriented** with strong attention to accuracy
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills
* Strong working knowledge of **Excel, Word, and PowerPoint**
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, documents, and online portals
* A quick learner who is comfortable figuring out new systems
* Patient, professional, and friendly communication style
* Able to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Reliable, responsible, and able to work independently
* Someone who naturally likes to **organize, structure, and improve systems**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Previous administrative, office, food industry, customer service, or data\-entry experience is a plus

**The Right Person for Fit Foodz**

We're looking for someone who doesn't just complete a task, but notices when something could be **better organized, easier to find, or more efficient**.

If you are the type of person who enjoys getting a messy spreadsheet cleaned up, creating order out of a cluttered filing system, catching small details others miss, and learning new programs quickly, you could be a great fit for our team.

**Why Join Fit Foodz?**

* Join a growing food company
* Work in a collaborative office environment
* Opportunity to take ownership of important administrative systems
* Opportunity to learn and grow with the company
* Be an important part of keeping our operations organized and efficient

**To Apply:**

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction telling us why you would be a good fit for the Fit Foodz team.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Marketing & Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Marketing \& Development Coordinator**  

  

**Employment Type:** Full Time  

**Employment Classification:** Non\-exempt  

**Start Date:** October 2026  

**Apply By:** September 9, 2026  

**Salary:** $44,000 \- 45,000  

**Reports to:** Marketing Manager  

  

Trees Atlanta is a nationally recognized non\-profit community group that protects and improves Atlanta’s urban forest by planting, conserving, and educating. Founded in 1985, Trees Atlanta works tirelessly to address Atlanta’s tree loss, protect its forests, and create new greenspace. Empowered by its wonderful community of volunteers, Trees Atlanta serves the metro Atlanta area and has grown into one of Atlanta’s most widely known and supported nonprofit organizations.

  

  

**Job Description**  

  

Trees Atlanta is looking for an enthusiastic, committed individual who is excited to join a hard\-working, mission\-driven team as the Marketing \& Development Coordinator. This role will promote Trees Atlanta’s programs and events and support important marketing initiatives focused on fundraising and development, including supporting fundraising events, updating donor information, and entering data. You will report to the Marketing Manager and work closely with the Development team.  

  

**You will have the opportunity to:**


* Help create short\- and long\-term marketing and development plans, including media, promotions, and appeal schedules, with the Marketing and Development teams.
* Publish education and community events to Trees Atlanta’s online calendar and external event calendars (such as Facebook Events and local digital outlets). Produce coordinated promotional images and compelling event descriptions.
* Collect and organize Trees Atlanta's volunteer\- and staff\-generated photographs in our DAM (digital asset management) system.
* Create Mailchimp emails for donor appeals, including developing targeted mailing lists from donor data.
* Support seasonal fundraising campaigns: fulfill Holiday card orders; and support Root Ball ticketing, collect guest information, and answer guest inquiries. Root Ball is our major fundraising gala.
* Manage Root Ball silent auction listings; coordinate item pickup and fulfillment; prepare auction displays; and acknowledge donations.
* Send weekly donor communications, including acknowledgement statements, thank you cards, and tribute gift notifications.
* Update donor information in Salesforce, clean data for mailing lists, and report campaign results.

**What you need:**


* Commitment to Trees Atlanta’s mission and programs and the ability to present our work in an engaging and interesting way to various audiences.
* Proficiency using software and tools for content creation, such as MailChimp, Canva, and other equivalent and related tools.
* Experience with CRM and Excel is a plus.
* Collaborating with Google productivity tools, including Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Google Meet, etc.
* Excellent writing and proofreading skills.
* Collaborative and efficient work style, with the flexibility to balance competing priorities across Marketing and Development.
* High ethical standards, confidentiality, and strong attention to detail and accuracy, particularly when working with donor data and records.
* A valid driver’s license and willingness to drive for occasional auction item pickups and deliveries is a plus.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs of event and campaign materials (e.g., card boxes, auction items) as needed.
* Experience in development, marketing, administrative, or nonprofit support roles, or a degree in a related field of expertise.

**To Apply**  

Please submit an employment application. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume in order to complete and submit the application.  

  

**Background Verification Disclaimer:**


* All final candidates must pass both a criminal background check and drug screening; adverse results could impact hiring. (Trees Atlanta is a participant in the Federal Drug\-Free Workplace Program)
* All new hires must verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States of America. Trees Atlanta in compliance with regulations set by the Department of Homeland Security. Trees Atlanta is a registered E\-Verify employer.

jobs.title: Photo Studio Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**WHAT IS THE BRAND?**


Mashburn is an Atlanta\-based apparel and lifestyle brand founded in 2007\. The company designs, manufactures, and markets a nationally recognized collection of menswear (Sid Mashburn) and womenswear (Ann Mashburn), and other high\-quality, iconic brands. Mashburn aims to be the best in American style and service... a brand that offers luxury\-quality product at accessible prices, delivered with a memorable customer experience, and driven by a deeply personal brand voice that expresses the passion and inspiration of our founders.

**WHAT IS THE JOB?**


The **Photo Studio Operations Coordinator** is an entry level role that supports the day\-to\-day product logistics that keep photo studio and e\-commerce shoots running smoothly. This role is responsible for receiving, preparing, moving, and routing product throughout the studio lifecycle, from intake through post\-shoot processing. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys hands\-on operational work, thrives in a fast\-moving environment, and takes pride in keeping product and studio spaces organized, accurate, and efficient.

**WHAT ARE THE RESPONSIBILITIES?**

* Check incoming product into the studio from internal teams and partners
* Track counts and maintain visibility of physical product in the studio
* Organize product by shoot type, queue, and timing
* Unfold, steam, hang, and prep garments to studio standards
* Remove tags, pins, chalk marks, and complete additional sample prep as needed
* Execute rack setup, physical movement, and maintenance throughout shoots
* Move product between the studio, warehouse, HQ, design, and other required locations
* Coordinate alterations drop\-off and pickup
* Route product into the correct queues for on\-figure, flat lay, tailored, and other studio needs
* Pack and prepare shipments for fittings, catalog shoots, and other off\-site needs
* Support packing logistics for local, domestic, and international shoots
* Collect, sort, and route product after shoots to the appropriate next location
* Reconcile product after shoots and flag missing or damaged items
* Take garments to cleaners or flag items for further review when needed
* Maintain organization across racks, prep areas, storage zones, and studio workspaces
* Support seasonal studio resets, sample cleanup, and inventory turnover

**WHAT ARE THE ESSENTIAL SKILLS?**

* 1–3 years of experience in studio operations, fashion production, sample coordination, warehouse support, or related field.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage physical product accurately
* Comfortable with hands\-on garment prep and movement throughout the day
* Able to prioritize tasks and stay organized in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong communication and follow\-through
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and consistency
* Must have reliable personal transportation; this role requires some travel between studio, HQ, warehouse, and off\-site locations
* Ability to lift and carry up to 30 lbs. (bins, packed suitcases, garment bags, and boxed product)
* Experience working with apparel samples, studio workflows, or product logistics is a plus
* Reflects our core values of Hopeful, Helpful, Hardworking, Humble, Hospitable, Nimble, and Honest

jobs.title: Account Manager V, Commercial - National
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**
  

Develops and implements complex sales and retention strategy for health insurance or workers compensation accounts. Drives opportunities, resources, technology tools, and customer performance data (e.g., cost utilization, financial, clinical) to meet competitive revenue and growth targets. Builds and maintains relationships with customers, consultants, brokers, and/or channel partners, including providing information and highly advanced product knowledge, and resolving or escalating concerns. Demonstrates highly advanced knowledge of customer businesses and develops account strategies in alignment with customer goals. Collaborates internally and externally to develop account strategy, including driving communication, and recommending solutions to customers. Drives best practices and established timelines to execute sales and renewals, including administration, negotiations, presentations, rate, product and benefits. Is accountable for Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to support the sustained growth and competitive position of KP in the market.  

**Essential Responsibilities:**  

  

* Promotes learning in others by communicating information and providing advice to drive projects forward; builds relationships with cross\-functional stakeholders. Listens, responds to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; provides actionable feedback to others, including upward feedback to leadership and mentors junior team members. Practices self\-leadership; creates and executes plans to capitalize on strengths and improve opportunity areas; influences team members within assigned team or unit. Adapts to competing demands and new responsibilities; adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback. Models team collaboration within and across teams.
  
* Conducts or oversees business\-specific projects by applying deep expertise in subject area; promotes adherence to all procedures and policies. Partners internally and externally to make effective business decisions; determines and carries out processes and methodologies; solves complex problems; escalates high\-priority issues or risks, as appropriate; monitors progress and results. Develops work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines; coordinates and delegates resources to accomplish organizational goals. Recognizes and capitalizes on improvement opportunities; evaluates recommendations made; influences the completion of project tasks by others.
  
* Drives a positive customer experience and market turnaround expectations by: building and maintaining strategic relationships with customers, consultants, brokers, and/or channels while acting as the KP representative to drive contract, benefit/service, and renewal activities; demonstrating highly advanced product knowledge when educating customers, consultants, brokers, and/or channel partners, resolving complex questions or concerns; demonstrating a highly advanced understanding of prospect or customer business to ensure that Request for Renewal (RFR) response and engagement strategies are in alignment with customer goals; partnering with engagement team/specialist to drive engagement programs (e.g., member wellness); and providing accurate information including highly advanced recommendations for new products, benefits/services offerings, and pricing models to address customer, consultant, broker, and/or channel needs and guiding others to do the same.
  
* Demonstrates commitment to KP sales and retention goals by: implementing complex strategies to meet or exceed targets for retention and growth for accounts in the Book of Business; documenting progress on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), maintaining updated Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform, and guiding others to do the same; and driving the sustained growth and competitive position of KP in the market.
  
* Contributes to the execution of sales and renewals by: collaborating across teams to drive the RFR process for complex accounts, following established timelines and best practices; driving complex sales and renewals including administration, negotiations, and presentations and rate product and benefit/service validation; driving task progress across functions to facilitate the negotiation of complex and/or custom contracts and pricing; and developing and implementing strategies for cross\-sell and upsell to increase growth and retention.
  
* Supports internal and external communication by: driving collaboration across functions to develop account strategy; guiding the flow of information across functions to advance the process of meeting deadlines and objectives; providing highly advanced recommendations to customer channels on all aspects of health benefits/services strategy and offering; and representing the marketplace perspective to inform strategic direction and decision\-making of senior leadership.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

jobs.title: National Account Manager
jobs.description:
**SUMMARY:**

FNA Group is a world class and leading manufacturer of consumer and industrial pressure washers and other outdoor power equipment. FNA's highly acclaimed brands include Simpson, Delco and CRX. Exclusive licenses with recognizable brands such as DeWalt, Stanley Black \& Decker and Craftsman further strengthens FNA's market presence and awareness. FNA is a dynamic organization with unprecedented growth due largely to its ability to attract and retain highly talented associates.


We have an excellent opportunity for a results\-oriented National Account Manager who can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.

 **Job Description:**


As a National Accounts Manager for FNA Group, you will report to the VP of Retail Sales and will be responsible for developing and growing key retail partnerships within the company's consumers portfolio. You will lead our sales initiatives with our customers in efforts of growing our business. Additionally, you will interface with FNA Group Demand Planning, Marketing, and Product teams in developing selling strategies, launching new products and aligning our forecast in efforts of delivering incremental business for your customers while maintaining targeted volume and profitability levels. The National Accounts Manager can work remotely from a home office in the southeastern United States.  



  

**Responsibilities:**

* Work directly with your merchant while collaborating cross\-functionally with each of your customer support teams with a purpose of delivering growth, expanded margins and brand awareness.
* Serve as the primary contact for your assigned retail accounts.
* Develop and manage annual account plans aligned with our company and our customers' objectives.
* Lead customer meetings, business line reviews, PLR and strategic planning sessions for your customers.
* Identify opportunities to expand distribution, assortment, revenue and market share.
* Responsible for forecasting of assigned product lines, both units and dollars, plus incremental promotional opportunities.
* Analyze POS, shipments, inventory, pricing, promotional performances and customer trends.
* Lead and prepare weekly/monthly recaps highlighting sales, forecasting updates, and opportunities ensuring both customers and FNA teams are aligned.
* Develop presentations, business reviews and strategic analyses for your customers.

 **Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 3 years of sales, account management or customer management experience.
* Experience in consumer products, durable goods, outdoor power equipment and home improvement related categories a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to interact with colleagues across all levels of an organization.
* Strong understanding of retail sales, merchandising, pricing, promotions and POS.
* Analytical and financial capabilities.
* Travel is required.

 **Education/Certification:**

* High School diploma or equivalent required.
* Degree is a plus, but not required.
* Certifications and/or training in related field is a plus.

jobs.title: Account Manager - In-house Agency - Maverick Studios

**COME JOIN OUR TEAM!**

Maverick Studios is where creativity meets impact. As the in\-house agency for Inspire Brands, we craft award\-winning work that spans design, video, photography, print, and beyond. Serving six iconic brands—Arby’s, Buffalo Wild Wings, Baskin\-Robbins, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and Sonic—our team is a powerhouse of collaboration and passion. We’re all about delivering best\-in\-class creativity, innovation, and solutions that resonate across every project.

At Inspire Brands, we’re not just dreamers; we’re doers. We thrive on innovation and welcome bold ideas at every level, from the kitchen to the boardroom. Here, taking risks and thinking differently aren’t just encouraged—they’re celebrated. It’s how we started, and it’s how we succeed.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


Do you have the magic touch when it comes to building relationships? Are you a pro at juggling deadlines, details, and deliverables with a smile? As our Account Manager, you’ll be the ultimate liaison between our clients and creative teams, ensuring projects are delivered seamlessly while keeping everyone delighted.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Client Whisperer:** Build strong, trusted relationships with clients, understanding their needs and making them feel like the VIPs they are.
* **Team Leader:** Manage and mentor a team of project intake specialists, ensuring they deliver exceptional service and have the tools to succeed.
* **Project Maestro:** Coordinate with internal teams to manage timelines, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring projects hit the mark every time.
* **Solution Seeker:** Address challenges with a “can\-do” attitude, turning potential hurdles into opportunities to shine.
* **Feedback Translator:** Collect, interpret, and communicate client feedback to the creative team with clarity and positivity.
* **Information Liaison:** Translate complex strategies, concepts, and project updates from the Maverick team into clear, concise, and client\-friendly communication that builds understanding and confidence.
* **Growth Catalyst:** Identify opportunities within accounts to leverage Maverick’s expertise in delivering speed, service, and savings. Expand our in\-house agency’s impact while driving growth for the brands we serve.
* **Master Organizer:** Keep project management tools updated and team members informed, making sure nothing slips through the cracks.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **Communication Superpowers:** You’re a natural at explaining ideas, resolving concerns, and making people feel heard.

* **Problem\-Solving Mojo:** Challenges don’t scare you—you thrive on finding solutions.
* **Collaborative Spirit:** You’re a team player who works well with diverse personalities and can rally a group around a common goal.
* **Positive Energy:** You bring good vibes, no matter the deadline or client curveball.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE**

* **People\-First Culture:** Join a supportive, collaborative team that values your input and celebrates your wins.
* **Dynamic Work Environment:** Every day is different, and you’ll never be bored!
* **Grow with Us:** Sharpen your skills and grow professionally with endless opportunities to learn and be challenged; your career will thrive in our dynamic team environment.
* **Creative Culture:** Join a team that knows how to balance hard work with the joy of celebrating our wins and each other’s work.
* **All the Extras:** From team outings, creative brainstorms, FREE ice cream, a beer/wine wall, and all the caffeine you can handle, we know how to celebrate success and fuel creativity.

**EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum 4 years \- Bachelor’s Degree
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or related fields and/or experience working in a brand marketing role or agency environment

**EXPERIENCE QUALIFICATION**

* Minimum 7\+ years spent working at a creative agency or in a brand marketing role
* Experience managing budgets
* Experience leading and growing teams
* Experience using Workfront or similar project management tools is a plus

**DECISION\-MAKING AUTHORITY**

* This role will have decision making authority over day\-to\-day work and will have approval authority as delegated and allowed by their manager.

**DIRECT REPORTS**

* Yes, full\-time and contract positions

**READY TO BE THE CLIENT’S FAVORITE PERSON?**

If you’re an organizational powerhouse with a knack for building client relationships and delivering top\-tier marketing projects, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and help Maverick Studios keep the creative momentum going strong!

  


Inspire is a multi\-brand restaurant company whose portfolio includes more than 33,300 Arby’s, Baskin\-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and SONIC restaurants worldwide. We’re made up of some of the world’s most iconic restaurant brands, but we’re much more than just a restaurant company. We’re a team of hundreds of thousands who individually and collectively are changing the way people eat, drink, and gather around the table. We know that food is much more than a staple—it’s an experience. At Inspire, that’s our purpose: to ignite and nourish flavorful experiences.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Pet Specialty
jobs.description:
**Key Account Manager – Pet**  

**Location:** Atlanta, GA (In\-Office)  

**Reports to:** Sr. Sales Manager  

**Category Focus:** Pet Specialty Channel

* Grow distribution and sales volume within assigned Pet Specialty accounts
* Strengthen distributor relationships to expand market presence and execution
* Become a trusted partner to customers through strategic planning and consistent engagement
* Contribute to category growth through promotions, pricing strategies, and market insights

* Demonstrate a growth\-oriented, proactive sales approach focused on building and expanding strategic relationships
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards while representing Inaba in a professional manner
* Perform additional duties as assigned

  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field
* 3–7 years of experience in sales within Pet Specialty, Food \& Beverage, or adjacent CPG categories
* Experience calling on headquarters, regional offices, and/or managing distributor relationships
* Strong ability to analyze trends, data, and sales performance metrics
* Proficiency in creating compelling PowerPoint sales presentations
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities
* Experience working cross\-functionally with internal teams and external partners
* Ability to travel locally or regionally as needed, including time spent in the field
* Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

 **Why Join Inaba Foods**

* Growing U.S. business with expanding distribution and increasing market presence
* Long\-term stability and leadership from a well\-established Japanese parent company

**Relationships That Drive Results. Success That Lasts.**
---------------------------------------------------------


Our Account Managers serve as the go\-to contact for our customers, embodying our purpose to make construction better by being their partner for productivity, safety, and sustainability. You will manage your own portfolio of customer accounts and be given ownership to build a work schedule that best suits you and your customers. You’ll make sales by maintaining customer relationships, demonstrating our latest tools on the spot, and providing high level customer consultation.  

  



**What You'll do**
------------------


* Building relationships – you’ll meet with customers at a moment’s notice or be actively present to capture the perfect business opportunity. You understand to create value in account(s) through long\-term, profitable relationships
* Time and Territory Management (TTM) \- creating a daily schedule (including presence on jobsites and client offices) to optimize client potential and sales productivity by zone territory
* Be a Hilti Champion – you’ll carry the technical knowledge to present high level customer consultations in your defined territory and represent the Hilti brand in the marketplace
* Tracking your progress – you’ll utilize Salesforce to record all the interactions you had to make a sale as reporting is a key part of this role

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------


* High School Diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent work experience
* At least three years of outside sales experience – preferably in an environment with set targets
* Hands\-on attitude – you'll be demonstrating our tools to our customers, using platforms such as Salesforce to keep track of everything, and collaborate with a variety of departments
* Maintain a valid driver’s license – we'll provide you with a company car, be sure you’re ready to drive
* Excellent time and territory management skills
* Must be able to walk on construction projects, climb scaffolding, and lift as much as 65 pounds at any given time
* Work a flexible and varied schedule

**What’s In It for You**
------------------------


We are committed to caring for our people, which is why our retention has been over 90% for the last five years. It’s why we haven’t gone through any waves of layoffs – even during the COVID\-19 pandemic. We value development, which is why 80\-90% of our roles are filled internally. It’s why most of our account managers come from a non\-construction background.
  

Success at Hilti comes down to teamwork and ability – the Hilti culture is contagious, and we have an excellent mix of people who are always looking to help one another.
  

  

This job is \#LI\-Hybrid, meaning it is field\-based and requires daily customer in\-person interaction with your home serving as your office location.  

  



**Why Hilti**
-------------


Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.  

  



**Commitment to Inclusion**
---------------------------


At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.  

  



Hilti, Inc is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. jobs.title: Multifamily Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) supports the Project Manager and Superintendent in the successful planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of ground\-up multifamily construction projects. This position is responsible for helping manage project documentation, subcontractor coordination, procurement, cost control, scheduling, change management, and communication between the field, ownership, design team, and subcontractors.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, technically capable, and interested in developing into a Project Manager role within the multifamily construction industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Management \& Coordination**

* Assist the Project Manager with the day\-to\-day management of multifamily construction projects from preconstruction through closeout.
* Coordinate with the Superintendent, subcontractors, architects, engineers, consultants, vendors, and ownership representatives.
* Participate in owner, architect, contractor (OAC) meetings and subcontractor coordination meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, action\-item lists, and follow\-up documentation.
* Help identify project risks, delays, scope gaps, and coordination issues before they impact the schedule or budget.

**Submittals \& RFIs**

* Manage and maintain project submittal logs.
* Review subcontractor submittals for completeness prior to forwarding them to the design team.
* Track submittal approvals and ensure materials are released in accordance with the project schedule.
* Prepare, issue, and track Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Coordinate RFI responses with the field team and affected subcontractors.
* Maintain current construction drawings, specifications, ASIs, RFIs, and other project documents.

**Procurement \& Subcontractor Management**

* Assist with subcontractor bidding, bid leveling, scope review, and contract preparation.
* Help confirm subcontractor scopes are complete and consistent with project plans and specifications.
* Track subcontract agreements, purchase orders, insurance requirements, and required documentation.
* Maintain procurement logs for long\-lead materials and equipment.
* Coordinate material releases and delivery requirements with the project schedule.

**Cost Management**

* Assist with maintaining project budgets, commitments, and cost reports.
* Review subcontractor change\-order requests and supporting documentation.
* Prepare potential change orders and owner change\-order documentation.
* Track project contingency, allowances, and pending cost exposures.
* Assist with subcontractor pay applications and monthly owner billing.
* Verify that subcontractor billing corresponds with actual work completed in the field.

**Scheduling**

* Work with the Project Manager and Superintendent to maintain the overall construction schedule.
* Assist with preparation and distribution of two\-week and three\-week look\-ahead schedules.
* Monitor procurement activities and subcontractor commitments against schedule requirements.
* Identify activities that could affect critical\-path construction.
* Help coordinate building turnover, inspections, punch\-list activities, and unit delivery schedules.

**Field Coordination**

* Maintain a regular presence in the field and work closely with the Superintendent and Assistant Superintendent.
* Review construction progress against plans, specifications, and project requirements.
* Participate in quality\-control inspections and punch walks.
* Assist with resolving field coordination issues involving multiple trades.
* Track completion of corrective work and outstanding punch\-list items.
* Help coordinate municipal inspections, third\-party inspections, testing, and owner inspections.

**Project Documentation**

* Maintain organized and accurate electronic project files.
* Track RFIs, submittals, change orders, procurement, inspections, meeting minutes, and other project correspondence.
* Help maintain current drawing sets and ensure field personnel have access to the latest documents.
* Assist in maintaining daily and weekly reporting as required.
* Document significant project issues and decisions through written correspondence.

**Project Closeout**

* Coordinate collection of warranties, attic stock, spare materials, operation and maintenance manuals, and closeout documentation.
* Track subcontractor punch\-list completion.
* Assist with obtaining final inspections, Certificates of Occupancy, and other required approvals.
* Coordinate turnover documentation with ownership and property management.
* Assist with subcontractor final payments, lien releases, and project financial closeout.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Building Construction, Engineering, Architecture, or related field preferred.
* 3–5 years of commercial or multifamily construction experience preferred.
* Experience with ground\-up multifamily, wood\-frame, podium, garden\-style, wrap, or similar residential construction is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, contracts, submittals, RFIs, and change orders.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing and subcontractor coordination.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and construction management software.
* Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, BuildingConnected, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple responsibilities in a fast\-paced construction environment.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to recognize potential scope, cost, and schedule issues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with office and field personnel.

**Preferred Multifamily Experience**

Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:

* Wood\-frame multifamily construction
* Unit turnover and phased building delivery
* Building envelope and waterproofing
* MEP coordination
* Elevators
* Fire

**Company Description** Plift is a high\-growth beverage startup offering delicious hemp\-infused drinks that are high on taste and low on calories. Designed for social gatherings, solo moments, and everything in between, Plift focuses on creating enjoyable, approachable products for a wide range of occasions. The brand emphasizes quality ingredients, refreshing flavor profiles, and a relaxed, inclusive experience. Team members join a growing company in a dynamic consumer packaged goods space with opportunities to contribute to brand expansion and market presence.

**Role Description** The Sales Operations Coordinator is a full\-time, remote role for our Chicago\-based company. We will be prioritizing candidates who are local to Chicago and who can join for weekly in\-person meetings and co\-working days. This role supports the sales team with daily operational tasks, including maintaining sales records, updating customer and account information, and preparing reports and dashboards to track performance. The coordinator will assist with order processing, inventory coordination, and communication between sales, customer service, and distribution partners to ensure smooth execution of sales activities. Responsibilities also include responding to internal and external inquiries, supporting the onboarding of new accounts, and helping streamline processes and tools to improve overall sales efficiency. This position works closely with sales and operations leadership teams to ensure consistent and accurate data entry and data management for decision\-making.

**Year\-one deliverables**

* Take full ownership of the full wholesale order processing cycle from receiving purchase orders to sending invoices, to entering order data into 3PL system, as well as initiating and managing freight.
* Support in the selection and implementation of an ERP by end of Q1 next year.
* Build lot code traceability into every B2B and distributor shipment.
* Cut the time from PO received to invoice issued to under 4 business hours, measured weekly.Cut DSO (days sales outstanding) by 15 days through systematic AR follow\-up.
* Reduce freight cost as a percent of revenue by 1–2 points through carrier negotiation and lane consolidation across all carriers and freight brokers.
* Build a distributor onboarding playbook so the next 10 distributors do not require co\-founder time to get live.

**Day\-to\-day responsibilities**

* Own the full order\-to\-cash lifecycle: PO receipt → invoice → freight booking → BOL → delivery confirmation → payment.
* Coordinate freight with C.H. Robinson and distributor\-managed carriers. Own freight quotes, lane decisions, and freight\-add\-to\-invoice decisions.
* Manage the relationship with 3PLs on warehouse SLAs. Hold them accountable to ship windows and lot code accuracy.
* Reconcile shortages, damages, and mis\-shipments. Issue credit memos through Belay Financial without assistance from Director of Ops or COO.
* Run a weekly ops review with Director of Ops: aging AR, open POs, OOS risk, freight spend, exceptions.
* Be the escalation point for distributor billing disputes

**Required experience**

* 5–8 years in sales operations, supply chain, or order management at a CPG, beverage, or distributed consumer goods company.
* Has personally led at least one ERP implementation or major migration. NetSuite, Fishbowl,

Encompass, or beverage\-specific platform preferred.

* Hands\-on with three\-tier alcohol or hemp beverage distribution. If not, then deep DSD or

wholesale\-broker experience that translates.

* Strong QuickBooks Online familiarity.
* Has owned freight relationships, not just submitted tickets to a 3PL.
* Comfortable in spreadsheets at a power\-user level (pivot tables, lookups, basic SQL or Looker a plus).

**Nice to have﻿**

* Experience with hemp, cannabis, or alcohol regulatory compliance (state\-by\-state license tracking, METRC, MN OCM, etc.).
* Has worked with Belay Financial or another fractional accounting firm.
* Has been the first ops hire at a sub\-$10M revenue company before.

* Develop deep product and competitor knowledge and understanding of local and regional market trends
* Analyze local trends, identifying long and short\-term goals to craft a strong product business plan
* Collaborate and partner with peers in the sales organization, brand team and other support partners to deliver an extraordinary customer experience
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner
* Execute the company brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area
* Participation in training and development programs
* Maintain adherence and compliance with all corporate, industry policies and procedures

 **Essential Requirements:**

* BA/BS degree required, Life Sciences preferred
* Business to business sales experience or internship experience and/or sales degree or 2\+ years of pharmaceutical experience
* Ability to identify key decision makers, develop positive relationships and strong customer dedication and influence prescribing habits
* Ability to learn, apply, and communicate products and disease states
* Proven track record of success in exceeding results
* Team player who can also work independently, highly collaborative and motivated to succeed
* Strong communication, business analytics and account management skills

 **Desired Requirements:**

* Respiratory Experience

program

case series and development of teams and programs

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant**
=======================


**Job Details**
---------------


**Job Title:** Executive Assistant


**Location:** Chicago, IL \| Hybrid \| **Must be able to commute to the Chicago Office**


**Compensation:** $75,000\-$95,000 annually, commensurate with experience


**Bonus:** Performance bonus eligibility


**Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off and company holidays; and more!


**About the Company**
---------------------



Alta HR is hiring on behalf of a growing Chicago\-based company operating in the health optimization space. The organization also has an affiliated nonprofit focused on advancing education and access within health optimization.



The environment is fast\-paced, the areas of responsibility are wide. This is an opportunity to work closely with a highly involved CEO and have a front\-row seat to two growing organizations.


**The Role**
------------



We are looking for an Executive Assistant who protects the CEO's time, runs his calendar and inbox with judgment rather than instruction, and closes loops without being chased.



This is a classic gatekeeper role performed at a very high level. AI usage will be expected; the right candidate will work smarter, improve systems, and increase the capacity of the executive function.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


* **Calendar and time management:** Own the CEO's calendar end to end, resolve conflicts, protect focus time, and serve as the first filter for inbound meeting requests.
* **Inbox and communication:** Triage email and Slack, surface what requires the CEO's attention, draft correspondence in his voice, and ensure important items never sit unresolved.
* **Meetings and follow\-through:** Prepare agendas, capture notes and action items, track commitments, and drive follow\-up across the leadership team.
* **Projects:** Own discrete projects from start to finish, including research, vendor coordination, document preparation, and operational initiatives.
* **Travel and events:** Coordinate domestic and international travel, itineraries, event logistics, and contingency planning.
* **AI and systems:** Use AI for drafting, research, summarization, meeting notes, and data cleanup. Build templates, automations, and SOPs that reduce recurring manual work.
* **Executive and personal support:** Handle administrative and personal requests with discretion, including appointments, reservations, expenses, reimbursements, and other executive logistics.
* **Relationship management:** Serve as a trusted and professional point of contact for internal leaders, physicians, partners, vendors, and other external relationships.

**Experience \& Qualifications**
--------------------------------



We're looking for someone who brings:


* **2\+ years of experience** supporting a senior executive, founder, or entrepreneur, ideally in a smaller or fast\-growing organization where you have worn multiple hats.
* **Genuine interest in health and wellness, longevity, health optimization, supplements, or life sciences.** A clinical background is not required, but an interest in the space is.
* **Exceptional attention to detail.** You catch the wrong date, missing attachment, typo, or unfinished follow\-up before it becomes a problem.
* **Strong project management skills.** You can take an ambiguous request, break it into steps, establish priorities and deadlines, and follow through without constant supervision.
* **Clear, concise, and professional communication skills**, both written and verbal.
* **Working knowledge of AI tools.** Experience using tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve your work is a plus.
* **Absolute discretion** when handling sensitive business, financial, and personal information.
* **Comfort with ambiguity and change.** Plans change and priorities shift; you can adapt and re\-sequence without losing momentum.
* **Proactive ownership.** You anticipate what is needed, bring solutions rather than problems, and do not wait to be chased.
* Fluency with **Google Workspace, Slack, and project management tools**, with the ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Ability to work from the company's **Chicago office on a hybrid schedule**.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Event or conference coordination experience
* Experience with e\-commerce, training, accounting, or other operational platforms
* Social media management experience
* Experience building automations using tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n

**How We Work**
---------------



The team values clear communication, agility, generosity, conscientiousness, and curiosity. People are expected to communicate early, adapt quickly, do the small things well, help without keeping score, and ask thoughtful questions rather than simply accepting the status quo.



This is a high\-accountability environment for someone who enjoys moving quickly, solving problems, and making the people around them more effective.


**Compensation \& Benefits**
----------------------------


* $75,000\-$95,000 base salary, can vary depending on experience
* Performance bonus eligibility
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Wellhub
* Learning and development allowance
* Employee product allowance
* Direct exposure to the leadership of two growing organizations

MedGEO is a healthcare technology company transforming how procedural care is documented, understood, and optimized at the point of care. Built by clinicians for clinicians, MedGEO combines intelligent automation, AI, and Smart Vision technology to reduce documentation burden, improve data accuracy, strengthen compliance, and provide healthcare organizations with greater visibility into the clinical, operational, and financial performance of procedural care.

Our technology works directly within operating rooms and procedural environments, helping nurses and clinicians spend less time on administrative tasks and more time focused on patients.

About the Role

MedGEO is seeking a highly motivated **Clinical Implementation \& Customer Success Manager** to lead customer onboarding, clinical implementation, training, go\-live support, adoption, and ongoing customer success for our healthcare technology platform.

new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co\-Founder \& CEO to lead Omnex, an AI\-native operating system for multi\-channel ecommerce sellers, currently in build at our studio. This is a co\-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.


Today's e\-commerce businesses run on fragmented software and manual coordination. Sellers operating across Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Walmart, and other channels constantly switch between dashboards, reconcile conflicting data, and make hundreds of operational decisions every day across pricing, inventory, advertising, fulfillment, and customer support.


The opportunity sits within a global ecommerce market exceeding $1 trillion in annual GMV, where millions of sellers increasingly operate across multiple channels but lack any unified operational intelligence layer.


Market Context
Omnex replaces this fragmented workflow with an autonomous, multi\-agent AI workforce. Instead of giving sellers another dashboard, Omnex continuously understands the business, reasons across every sales channel, and proactively executes operational decisions—from optimizing pricing and inventory to managing advertising, forecasting demand, and coordinating customer support. Every AI agent shares the same business context, learns from outcomes, and works together to optimize the business as a whole.


About FutureSight
FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co\-creates world\-class software companies with values\-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.


You’ll co\-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E\&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co\-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow\-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0\-to\-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.


The Partnership* Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
* Pre\-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow\-on funding
* Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
* Investor and advisor network across logistics, vertical AI, and early\-stage capital markets
* A true co\-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross\-functional team as your partner


What you'll own
As Co\-Founder \& CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

* Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
* Customer Development — Lead pilots with ecommerce sellers, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go\-to\-market motion
* Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
* Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
* Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company


Co\-Founder Profile* Previous founding experience at a venture\-backed company
* Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go\-to\-market, including sales and customer engagement
* Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
* Clear\-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co\-founding a venture\-backed company
* Direct experience in ecommerce — operated a multi\-channel business, sold software into this market, or built tools for ecommerce sellers at scale
* Network within the ecommerce seller community (Amazon sellers, Shopify operators, 3PL partners)


How to Apply
Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.


FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

new_jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.


If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco, San Jose, or Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

  

The Technical Account Manager owns the technical health of the post\-sales relationship for Lambda’s public cloud accounts, spanning AI\-native startups, Enterprises, and Fortune 500 companies. Where the Customer Success Manager owns the commercial health of an account, you own its technical health: the customer’s workloads run well, the architecture is right, the SLA story is defensible, and technical risk is found and retired before it threatens revenue. Solutions Engineering carries the account through pre\-sales and hypercare; at handoff, you take ownership of the technical relationship for the life of the contract.


This is a hands\-on role, not a coordination role. You will understand what customers are actually building (training runs, fine\-tuning pipelines, inference services) deeply enough to lead joint POC sessions, design and defend architectures, validate SLA events at the root\-cause level, and build the tooling that makes account health measurable. You will be the customer’s most credible technical advocate inside Lambda and Lambda’s most trusted technical voice inside the account.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the technical health of your accounts. Take the technical handoff from Solutions Engineering at the end of hypercare and own the account’s technical outcomes through steady state, expansion, and renewal. Know the state of every cluster and workload you are accountable for, and keep your commercial counterparts ahead of technical risk.
* Understand customer AI use cases end to end. Map what it means for each customer to train, fine\-tune, and serve models on Lambda: frameworks, schedulers, parallelism strategy, data paths, and performance baselines. Build the customer user journey and convert it into value\-add opportunities across the platform, documentation, and escalation routing.
* Lead joint customer POC sessions. Define success criteria with the customer before a node is provisioned: acceptance thresholds, benchmarks, timelines. Own the execution plan, coordinate capacity and provisioning, run or oversee the tests, and drive the POC to a clear verdict: win the workload, close the gap through product, or qualify out.
* Lead customer architecture designs. Produce and defend reference architectures spanning compute, networking, storage, connectivity, and scheduler integration (Slurm, Kubernetes). Make support boundaries explicit: what is managed and what is not. Own the design as it evolves after handoff, pulling in engineering domain experts with specific, well\-framed questions.
* Own SLA and reliability engineering. Build and own the canonical methodology for uptime, downtime, and credit calculation. Validate breach events at the technical level, down to the specific Ethernet or InfiniBand failure, and arm CSMs and leadership with defensible numbers. Partner with product to standardize SLA language and structure across 1CC, on\-demand, and reserved offerings.
* Build the tooling that makes accounts measurable. Own the technical data surfaces for customer health end to end: dashboards, telemetry and uptime history views, health scoring, and churn early\-warning signals. Scope, build, and drive adoption. Replace “escalate to engineering to answer a basic question” with self\-serve data for the whole GTM org.
* Direct technical escalations and incidents. Serve as the technical lead during high\-severity events on your accounts: drive root cause, hold the quality bar on RCAs, coordinate engineering, support, and vendors (NVIDIA, storage, networking), and give account teams a technically accurate narrative. Run proactive maintenance and known\-issue communication so customers hear about problems from Lambda first.
* Drive the technical voice of the customer. Run a structured feature\-request pipeline into product with committed triage timelines. Audit the platform hands\-on by provisioning as a customer and testing known friction points. Lead product\-led POCs (for example, NVIDIA NIM) that open new value for customers.
* Know the market technology landscape. Track GPU roadmaps, competing clouds and neoclouds, and the evolving training and inference stacks. Brief customers on what is coming and internal teams on where Lambda stands, and let that context shape architecture and expansion recommendations.

**You**

* 5\+ years in technical account management, solutions engineering or architecture, ML engineering, technical program or product management, or infrastructure engineering with significant customer\-facing scope, in cloud, HPC, or AI infrastructure.
* Hands\-on fluency with GPU infrastructure: able to provision, benchmark, and debug across compute, networking (InfiniBand, Ethernet), storage, and schedulers (Slurm, Kubernetes), and to read results critically.
* Working command of AI/ML workloads (training, fine\-tuning, inference) sufficient to map a customer’s stack, identify constraints, and lead technical conversations with their ML and infrastructure engineers.
* Track record leading structured technical engagements: POCs with defined success criteria, architecture designs, benchmark programs, or high\-severity escalations.

* Executive\-grade communication of deeply technical content, in writing and in the room.

new_jobs.title: Day & After School Program Associate Teacher
new_jobs.description:
**Berkwood Hedge School**  
**Associate Classroom Teacher and After\-School Program Teacher**

Berkwood Hedge School is seeking excellent candidates for Classroom Associate Teachers and After\-School Program Teachers for the 2026–2027 school year.

Berkwood Hedge School's program is based on the understanding that children construct their knowledge of the world through experiential, integrated, and project\-based learning. We allow our children to develop as creative participants in their own learning. Our teachers support our children's development across the cognitive, physical, social and moral domains and support our school in whatever capacity necessary to ensure excellence and success.

**Primary roles and responsibility of the Associate Classroom Teacher**

* Support classroom instruction that is consistent with our mission and pedagogy, and provide supervision during non\-instructional times.
* Instructional responsibilities involve contributing to and teaching lessons, working closely with the classroom teacher to coordinate curriculum and instruction, and with children to enhance learning.
* In addition to teaching responsibilities, associate teachers participate in the life of the school, including professional development, staff meetings, events, and snack and lunch duties.
* Work with individual children or small groups under supervision of the lead teacher.
* Prepare teaching materials as agreed upon by Head of School and/or directed by lead teacher.
* Perform clerical duties as related to classroom instruction.
* Assist in classroom management.
* Prepare lesson materials, bulletin board displays, exhibits, equipment, and demonstrations.
* Present subject matter to students under the direction and guidance of teachers, using lectures, discussions, and/or role\-playing methods.
* Coach and assist children individually or in small groups in order to help them master assignments and to reinforce learning concepts presented by teachers.
* Observe students' performance, and record relevant data to assess progress.
* Organize and supervise games and other recreational activities to promote physical, mental, and social development.
* Participate in agreed upon teacher\-parent conferences regarding students' progress or problems.
* Develop, file, and duplicate materials.
* Use computers, audiovisual aids, and other equipment and materials to enhance learning.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by Head of School.

**Primary role and responsibilities of the After School Program Teacher**

* Supervise ASP staff, including leading weekly staff meetings, providing staff support and evaluation.
* Oversee program planning, submit a quarterly plan.
* Plan and run After School events.
* Communicate with parents as their primary contact about their children's experience in After School.
* Prepare a weekly snack menu by Friday of the previous week and supervise daily snack.
* Purchase and monitor food and supplies.
* Monitor first aid supplies, emergency forms binder.
* Purchase and track use of art supplies and other materials, inventory twice a year: June and January.
* Lead and provide staffing for Conference and Professional Development days.

**The successful candidate will**

* Work enthusiastically to support planning and implementation of all aspects of the program.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues in all aspects of student learning.
* Maintain professional and thoughtful communication with all members of our community.
* Wholeheartedly support and manifest the Berkwood Hedge mission of social justice and equity.
* Be creative, innovative, flexible, and responsive.
* Have a sense of humor.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree — a teaching credential is desirable.
* Understanding of and appreciation for progressive education.
* Strong communication skills with both children and adults.
* An abiding interest in helping young people experience joy and success.

**Skills**

* Ability to provide customer service to BH families with frequent, engaging, and informative communication.
* Capacity to focus on the whole child, intentionally developing each individual academically, physically, emotionally, and socially.
* Ability to exercise daily flexibility by wearing many hats, prioritizing, and problem solving while maintaining a poised professional demeanor.
* Enthusiasm for incorporating global perspectives that expand students' circles of influence and cultural competency.
* Ability to utilize sound and developmentally appropriate educational practices related to technology.

**Qualities**

* Love of children and understanding of child development.
* Collaborative, creative, and curious nature.
* Maturity, professionalism, and good judgment.
* Willingness and capacity to assume a wide range of responsibilities.
* Interested in learning new skills and engaged in continuous improvement of practice.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.

**Additional Expectations**

* Maintain and support a climate of mutual respect which encourages students to take healthy risks: asking questions, sharing opinions, and making mistakes necessary to learn.
* Cultivate each student's creativity, intellectual curiosity and social\-emotional development in an academically rich and relevant context.

At Berkwood Hedge, a teacher's engagement includes various activities in addition to teaching and classroom duties, such as giving extra help to students who need it, communicating feedback directly to the Head of School, encouragement of the efforts of colleagues, concern for the appearance of the classroom and of the grounds, promptness in meeting all School obligations, and flexibility and cooperation in supporting our school's advancement. Attendance at School events and activities, such as plays, concerts, festivals, and fairs, staff meetings, and open houses is required.

This position is full time and starts in September 2026\. We look for candidates who thrive on ownership

new_jobs.title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI E-commerce Operations System
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co\-Founder \& CEO to lead Omnex, an AI\-native operating system for multi\-channel ecommerce sellers, currently in build at our studio. This is a co\-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.


Today's e\-commerce businesses run on fragmented software and manual coordination. Sellers operating across Amazon, Shopify, eBay, Walmart, and other channels constantly switch between dashboards, reconcile conflicting data, and make hundreds of operational decisions every day across pricing, inventory, advertising, fulfillment, and customer support.


The opportunity sits within a global ecommerce market exceeding $1 trillion in annual GMV, where millions of sellers increasingly operate across multiple channels but lack any unified operational intelligence layer.


Market Context
Omnex replaces this fragmented workflow with an autonomous, multi\-agent AI workforce. Instead of giving sellers another dashboard, Omnex continuously understands the business, reasons across every sales channel, and proactively executes operational decisions—from optimizing pricing and inventory to managing advertising, forecasting demand, and coordinating customer support. Every AI agent shares the same business context, learns from outcomes, and works together to optimize the business as a whole.


About FutureSight
FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co\-creates world\-class software companies with values\-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.


You’ll co\-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E\&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co\-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow\-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0\-to\-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.


The Partnership* Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
* Pre\-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow\-on funding
* Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
* Investor and advisor network across logistics, vertical AI, and early\-stage capital markets
* A true co\-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross\-functional team as your partner


What you'll own
As Co\-Founder \& CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

* Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
* Customer Development — Lead pilots with ecommerce sellers, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go\-to\-market motion
* Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
* Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
* Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company


Co\-Founder Profile* Previous founding experience at a venture\-backed company
* Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go\-to\-market, including sales and customer engagement
* Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
* Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
* Clear\-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co\-founding a venture\-backed company
* Direct experience in ecommerce — operated a multi\-channel business, sold software into this market, or built tools for ecommerce sellers at scale
* Network within the ecommerce seller community (Amazon sellers, Shopify operators, 3PL partners)


How to Apply
Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.


FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who we are**
--------------


Altimate AI provides an expert agentic data engineering harness to automate the work of data teams. These generate data pipelines, write data documentation/tests, and optimize data infrastructure autonomously. In particular they help to automatically reduce the total cost of ownership on Databricks and Snowflake.


Teams using Altimate.ai have seen 3x accelerated data development and up to 30% reduction in cloud data infrastructure costs. Altimate is used by hundreds of companies and thousands of weekly active users. Read more about us in this VentureBeat Article.


We are a Series A startup of 50\+ people, distributed across India (mainly Bangalore) and the US. Working here means short deadlines, juggling several things at once, adapting quickly, and making calls without complete information. If you have done marketing at a startup, you will recognize this.

**Role summary**
----------------


Reporting directly to the head of marketing, you will run the execution engine of our marketing team: the systems, the channels, the publishing cadence, and the reporting that tells us what is working.


This is a hands\-on role covering the full range of digital marketing mechanics: marketing automation, email, blog publishing, social, events, and reporting. Search/answer\-engine visibility, and email outreach/deliverability are two immediate priorities, and we will increase the scope of the role over time based on the skills and interests of the successful candidate along with company priorities.


We are a small team, so we would rather shape the role around what you are good at than hold you to a fixed spec. If you bring depth in something we have not listed (paid acquisition, lifecycle, partner marketing, ABM) we will make room for it if it fits our strategy, and fill the gap elsewhere with contract help or other people on the team.


As an AI\-native company, we expect you to work the way we build product: using agentic AI tools, skills, and scheduled automations to scale your own output, and not doing everything by hand.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Marketing systems and automation.** HubSpot is our system of record: segments, properties, workflows, forms, campaign tracking, and integrations with the rest of our stack. You will be the primary system owner.

**Search and answer\-engine visibility (AEO/SEO).** On\-site and off\-site work across altimate.ai and help.altimate.ai: technical SEO, on\-page optimization, structured data, site architecture and internal linking, backlinks and listings, and optimization for AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). Build the measurement that shows whether it is working.

**Email and newsletter.** Manage the subscription list and opt\-in process. Build, schedule, and send a regular newsletter from material our engineering team and contract writer produce. Own hygiene, segmentation, and deliverability. Set KPIs and own the process for meeting them.

**Blog publishing and distribution.** Get engineering\- and writer\-authored articles live (Hashnode today, though we may change the publication flow), then build exposure for them: syndication, communities, newsletters, cross\-posting.

**Social channels.** Own our channels day to day. Turn existing long\-form content into posts, judge which channels are worth our effort, and grow reach. You are not writing the source material, but you need judgment about what will land where.

**Analytics and reporting.** Track numbers from GA4, PostHog, Google Search Console, HubSpot, OpenSEO and elsewhere and act on them.

**Digital events.** Webinars and online events end to end: platform, registration workflow, promotion, reminders, follow\-up, reporting.

**In\-person event logistics.** Coordinate our presence at conferences and meetups in North America and Europe — venue and vendor bookings, shipping, schedules, promotion, lead capture, follow\-up. We also expect to run occasional events in India (meetups, recruiting events) that you would help promote.

**Where this role goes long term**
----------------------------------


To start off, we are hiring an individual contributor. As the team scales, we expect this role to grow into leading a small team, and we are looking for someone with the ambition and judgment to step up when that happens. If your goal is to stay a pure IC indefinitely, this is not the right fit.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

* **Not a content writing role.** Our existing team produce the blog posts, newsletter articles, and SEO content. You help project manage and distribute that work; you do not author it.
* **Not a design role.** Visual creative is handled elsewhere.
* **Not a product\-technical role.** You do not need to understand data engineering our product internals to do this job well, but a demonstrated familiarity with software development and data engineering would be a big plus.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **4\+ years in digital marketing, 6 preferred**, with meaningful time in startups or small multi\-channel marketing teams.
* **Hands\-on ownership of a marketing automation tools:** configuring it, not just working inside something someone else built.
* **Email marketing infrastructure experience**: selecting or implementing an ESP, migrating a contact database, building a compliant opt\-in flow, and diagnosing genuine deliverability problems. Just sending campaigns inside an already\-healthy system is not the same thing.
* **Technical SEO you have done yourself:** schema, site architecture, crawl and index health — plus a current, practical point of view on AEO.
* **Self\-sufficiency in the tools**: GA4, Google Search Console, HubSpot, Ahrefs/Semrush/OpenSEO or equivalent.
* **Practical fluency with agentic AI tools:** specific workflows and automations you have built and run, not general familiarity.
* **Operational reliability.** A large part of this job is rec

* *Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry\-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success**?*
* *Are you looking to join a fast\-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?*

If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.


In this role, you will work within a defined geographic territory that targets clients and prospects with 1\-49 employees. You will identify and sign new clients for payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and more and sell additional solutions to existing clients. Daily, you will cultivate relationships, set appointments, gather leads from established business partners, assess client or prospect needs to present the best ADP solutions, and spend your time in the field closing business. Don't worry if you have no prior sales experience; we are known for our high\-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest sales technology to set you up for success.


Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse to lose attitude are must\-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment \- all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry\-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.


Ready to \#MakeYourMark? **Apply now!**


**To learn more about Sales at ADP**, watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales\_Videos

* **Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.** You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
* **Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.** You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision\-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
* **Deepen** **Relationships Across the ADP Family.** In addition to selling cloud\-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all business; you will make life\-long friendships here.

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE****:** *Required Qualifications*


* **Positive Self\-Starter****.** You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection, manage your time well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in\-person, and over the phone.
* **Agile Solution Seeker****.** You're a problem solver who can find an answer, or a solution, even in times of fast\-paced change.
* **Continuous Learner****.** You're always learning, growing, and questioning how things were done in the past to make them even better.

A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:
* One to two years of prior work experience or internships in Retail, Marketing, Business Development, Food Service, Insurance Sales, or another relevant industry, OR
* Military experience We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem\-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.
**Bonus points for these:** *Preferred Qualifications*


* Prior quota\-carrying experience
* Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**

* **Be your healthiest.** Best\-in\-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
* **Balance work and life.** Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
* **Focus on your mental health and well\-being.** We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
* **Join a company committed to giving back** and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
* **Get paid to pay it forward.** Company\-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

What are you waiting for? **Apply today!**
